headline: IT services revenue grew solidly in Q2 FY27, led by high‑growth mid‑caps while top‑tier growth slowed.
summary: Overall sector revenue rose 11% YoY, driven by strong AI‑led deals at several firms. Mid‑size players such as Coforge posted exceptional double‑digit growth, whereas Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance to 1‑2% and saw only 1.5% revenue growth. Profit margins improved for most companies, with HCLTech and TCS maintaining high operating margins above 18%. AI revenue contributions are becoming a material part of earnings, especially at HCLTech and Mphasis.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: AI‑related contracts accounted for a large share of new deals, boosting revenue growth at HCLTech, Mphasis and LTM.

themes.title: Guidance tightening at the top tier
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue growth outlook, reflecting slower macro demand and modest top‑line expansion.

themes.title: Margin expansion at large players
themes.detail: TCS and HCLTech kept operating margins above 18%, supporting profit growth despite modest top‑line gains.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY, the highest growth in the peer set and margin guidance was raised.
Revenue up 13.6% YoY with strong AI‑led managed services wins.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and guidance is flat.
